note: Eight made-up postings at made-up companies (the Microsoft sample-company names), so the weekly digest runs offline. `python3 jobsearch.py digest --live` reads real public job boards instead; see data/targets.example.json.

postings.title: Head of AI Enablement
postings.text: Lead AI enablement for 3,000 employees. Run workshops and office hours, get ideas to working prototypes with the teams that asked, partner with leadership on AI priorities, and measure adoption.

postings.title: AI Adoption Product Manager
postings.text: Own intake and triage of AI requests from operations teams, ship prototypes with them, set accuracy targets with the model team, and work with data teams on data quality.

postings.title: AI Enablement Lead, Sales
postings.text: Build the training program that gets 400 sellers using AI every week. Run workshops, track usage and adoption metrics, and report to sales leadership.

postings.title: Senior Product Designer, AI
postings.text: Design AI features end to end, prototype in code, and run research with customers.

postings.title: Director, AI Transformation
postings.text: Run the AI portfolio: triage demand from every function, get the best ideas to prototypes, review priorities with the executive team, and measure the value delivered.

postings.title: Service Design Lead
postings.text: Redesign the returns service end to end, measure wait times and satisfaction before and after, and run workshops with store teams.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.text: Write production Python and TypeScript, deploy to Kubernetes, and build integrations on customer sites.

postings.title: AI Training Program Manager
postings.text: Coordinate AI training sessions and track attendance.
